name: B-39
source:
"We know how cruel and ugly the world is to people like you, B-39. People who are... stained by their demons. We chose to place our faith in you, to trust that those demons wouldn't rear their heads to plague us, too..."

[From [url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/b-39]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我们知道这个世界对像你这样的人是多么残酷和丑陋，B-39。这些人……被他们的恶魔玷污了。我们选择相信你，相信那些恶魔也不会抬头来困扰我们……”

[来自[url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/b-39]itch.io[/url]]
